controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by K2-18; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of this planet exists (it has never been resolved: its size, orbit and transmission spectrum are measured, not its surface; see the investigation ledger). The gray marks an unresolved surface; the lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of k2-18's light, as its colour lens measures it.
